about.title: Moorpark Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: A defective product doesn't announce itself before it fails — a faulty appliance, a car part that gives out on SR-118, a tool that malfunctions at a job site near Los Angeles Avenue. In Moorpark, residents encounter these products daily, and when one causes injury, California law often allows a strict liability claim, meaning the focus is on the defect itself rather than proving the manufacturer was negligent. That distinction matters because it can simplify what an injured person has to show. LawProactive is a free service that connects Moorpark residents with an independent attorney who evaluates these cases, including who may share responsibility — the manufacturer, the distributor, or the retailer. If you were hurt by a product anywhere in Ventura County, from a household item to equipment used on Tierra Rejada Road job sites, connecting with an attorney early can help preserve the product and the evidence tied to it. There's no cost to get connected, and no obligation to move forward.

whyChoose.title: Why Moorpark Residents Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Strict Liability Can Ease Your Burden
items.desc: California often allows product liability claims under strict liability, meaning you may not need to prove the maker was careless — only that the product was defective and caused harm.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable, and an attorney can help identify every party connected to the defective product.

items.title: Preserving the Product Matters Early On
items.desc: Since the defect itself is central to these claims, an attorney can advise you on safely preserving the product before it's lost, altered, or discarded.

items.question: Do I have to prove the manufacturer was negligent?
items.answer: Not necessarily. Under California's strict liability framework, you generally need to show the product was defective — in its design, manufacturing, or warnings — and that the defect caused your injury. An independent attorney can review your situation and explain how this applies to your case.

items.question: What should I do with the product that hurt me in Moorpark?
items.answer: Try to keep it in the same condition it was in when the injury happened, including packaging, receipts, or manuals if you have them. This is especially important if the incident happened along busy corridors like Los Angeles Avenue or near SR-118 where evidence can be harder to track down later. An attorney can guide you on proper storage and documentation.

items.question: Is there a cost to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free service that connects you with an independent attorney, and attorneys in the network typically work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation. There's no obligation to proceed after your initial conversation.
